name: idstack
title_zh: 给AI教学材料做循证体检的11件套
tagline_zh: 从LMS导入课件，自动查对齐、无障碍、认知负荷和证据强度。不靠感觉改课，靠清单挑刺，每一条都标得出出处。
tagline_en: Import from any LMS, auto-check alignment, accessibility, cognitive load, and evidence strength. Critique courses.
desc_en: Evidence-based instructional design skills for Claude Code. 11 AI skills that check alignment, accessibility, cognitive load, and evidence strength. Import from any LMS or authoring tool.
why_zh: 把教学设计的隐性标准变成显式检查器，每个skill对应一条可追溯的证据链。不是泛泛建议。
why_en: Turns tacit instructional design standards into explicit checkers—each skill maps to a traceable evidence chain, diagnosing down.
limit_zh: 只认文本型课件（HTML/Markdown/文档导出），不解析视频音频；检查结论止于标注与建议，不自动改写内容。
limit_en: Text-only courses (HTML/MD/docs); no video/audio parsing. Outputs annotations & suggestions, not auto-rewrites. Needs internet for citation lookup.
